name: Onee-chan wa Kushizashikou!? ~Atashi no Kui de Tsuranuite Ageru~
original_name: お姉ちゃんは串刺し公！？ ～アタシの杭で貫いてあげる～
source: It began with the outrageous declaration of my sister Crea, who suffers from eighth-grader syndrome. Believing herself to be a reincarnation of Vlad the Impaler, she involves both me, her stepbrother, and her real sister Rakia in lewd schemes under the guise of reviving her memories. From impalement on a giant stake to handcuffs and a neck collar, and even a wooden horse! Crea's demands know no bounds. Are my sister's words just delusions or could they be truthful?
translation: 这一切始于我患有八年级学生综合症的妹妹克雷亚的无耻声明。她相信自己是穿刺者弗拉德的转世，以恢复她的记忆为幌子，让我、她的继兄和她真正的妹妹拉基亚参与了淫乱的计划。从巨桩上的刺穿到手铐和项圈，甚至还有木马！Crea的要求是无止境的。姐姐的话到底是错觉还是真的？
